description: Canonical Strand API surface. Every consumer type must implement this surface. The parity test reads this file and asserts conformance. Adding a primitive is a PR that updates this file AND adds the primitive to every consumer type in the same release. Removing a primitive requires a major version bump.

cssOnlyComponents.name: Banner
cssOnlyComponents.reason: Deliberately class-only. Its consumer injects the markup server-side (an HTMLRewriter writing .strand-banner before first paint) and never mounts a component, so the classes are the whole API. For the CSS-only and Bulma/Bootstrap consumer types that is the normal case rather than an exception.

Banner.note: Banner component exists in strand-ui but not in strand-svelte or strand-vue. Excluded from the parity manifest until Banner is added to all three framework libraries. Adding it is a parity-raising task in a future session.

notes: This manifest is the MVP parity contract. Extension to track prop shapes, CSS class names, and tokens is future work. The current contract asserts: (1) every component name here exists as a directory in every framework package's components folder, (2) every publishable package has the same version number.
foreignBlocksNote: Blocks a component stylesheet defines that are not its own, recorded so the debt is legible and cannot grow silently. Seeded 2026-08-12 from the sweep that added this invariant; every entry predates it. Three kinds are mixed here and they are not equally benign. (1) A component whose class name simply differs from its directory name -- Button/strand-btn, Tag/strand-chip, ScrollReveal/strand-reveal -- which is cosmetic. (2) A helper block that plainly belongs to its component, such as Table/strand-table-wrapper. (3) INDEPENDENT PRIMITIVES hiding in a neighbour: InstrumentViewport.css defines the search overlay, the results panel, the result card, the detail panel, the map pins, the cluster marker and the map legend, none of which has a component in any of the eight consumer types, a parity-manifest entry, or a test. Card.css defines five strand-channel-* blocks, which is consumer-specific markup in the library. Kind 3 is real work; kinds 1 and 2 may simply be recorded forever.
darkCabinetComponentsNote: The dark instrument cabinet (DL 9.3). Text in these components is painted on the abyss, never on a light surface, so contrast-check judges them against the dark surface. This was derived from InstrumentViewport.css alone until four primitives were given their own component directories; the derivation broke silently and reported six findings about colours that were correct. Membership is a decision, so it is declared rather than inferred from a file boundary. Add a component here only if its text genuinely never appears on a light surface.
